howItWorks.title: How we bring your car

selection.title: Selection and inspection
selection.description: You share your requirements: make, model, engine size, budget. We shortlist several options, check the Carfax history and send you a report for approval.

auction.title: Bidding and purchase
auction.description: Once approved, we sign an official contract and bid at Copart or IAAI on your behalf. We buy the car within the agreed price and send photos from the warehouse.

delivery.title: Delivery and handover
delivery.description: By sea to the port of Klaipeda, then by car carrier to you. Our customs broker handles the clearance — and you pick up a ready car. Around 44 days on average.

customs.question: How much does customs clearance cost?
customs.answer: It depends on fuel type, engine size, model year and the price of the car. The total is made up of import duty (10%), excise and VAT (20%). Excise is calculated from engine size and vehicle age. Our calculator or a manager will give you the exact figure.

turnkey.question: What is included in the turnkey price?
turnkey.answer: The lot price with the Copart or IAAI auction fee, delivery to the US port, ocean freight with insurance, forwarding, customs clearance with broker fees, car carrier to your city and our $200 fee. No charges beyond the agreed estimate.

damage.question: What if the car is damaged during shipping?
damage.answer: Every car is insured for the entire route. We photograph its condition at the US warehouse, at container loading and at handover. If damage occurs in transit, we file the insurance claim and cover the repair — you don't.

inspection.question: Can the car be inspected before purchase?
inspection.answer: Yes. Before bidding you receive a Carfax or AutoCheck report, the full auction photo set and our assessment of the damage. If needed, we send an expert to the lot for extra photos and video, plus an engine and body alignment check.

lostBid.question: What if we don't win the auction?
lostBid.answer: You lose nothing. The deposit carries over to the next lot in full or is refunded. We keep bidding on other options within the agreed budget until we buy your car.

delivery.question: How long does delivery take?
delivery.answer: On average 44 days from winning the bid to handover: 7–10 days for US inland logistics, 25–30 at sea to the port of Klaipeda, the rest for the car carrier and customs. The exact term depends on the state and the shipping line's load.

payments.question: What is the down payment and when is the rest due?
payments.answer: The bidding deposit starts at $500 and counts toward the price of the car. After winning, you pay the lot and the auction fee within 2 business days. Logistics and customs are paid before handover. Every amount is fixed in the contract before the first bid.

meta.title: About us — Revolution Auto: car import from the USA and Europe
meta.description: Revolution Auto is a team with 8+ years of experience importing cars from the USA, Europe, China and Korea. 600+ cars delivered turnkey: sourcing, bidding at Copart and IAAI, shipping and customs clearance. Based in Lviv, working across Ukraine.

intro.description: Revolution Auto is a Ukrainian company that brings cars from the USA, Europe, China and Korea turnkey. We went from being hired managers at other people's import companies to running our own team, one that walks each client from the first bid at Copart to the finished registration papers.

story.title: Our path: from managers at other companies to a team of our own

past.title: How it started
past.body1: In 2016 we started out as hired managers at companies importing cars from the USA. Hundreds of Copart and IAAI lots every day, Carfax reports, negotiations with brokers and container lines. That is where we learned to read auction photos, tell cosmetic damage from structural damage, and calculate customs clearance down to the last hryvnia.
past.body2: It is also where we saw the core problem of this market: clients were sold a car, not a result. Fees appeared only after the lot was won, delivery times from the USA kept slipping, and questions about the real state of the body got vague answers. We decided to build a service where every figure is known before the first bid.

present.title: Where we are now
present.body1: Since 2021 Revolution Auto has been our own team under one roof: sourcing and inspection, bidding at US auctions, ocean logistics, a customs broker and pre-sale preparation. Every area has a specific person accountable for it, so no client waits while a manager checks with the logistics guy.
present.body2: Today we import cars from the USA, Europe, China and Korea turnkey and have handed over more than 600 vehicles to their owners. The turnkey price is fixed in the contract before the first bid, every car is insured for the entire route, and clients get photo reports from the US warehouse, at container loading and before handover.
